title: Inoue's Jab, Body Shot and Balance, at Home
sub: Monday to Friday. Inspired by Naoya Inoue's style, not his exact program.
note: Inoue's power comes from the basics: a fast jab from the edge of range that measures you, body shots early so the guard comes down later, and balance, his weight over his feet on every punch so even the small ones land heavy.

items: Jab from the edge of range
Step in, jab at full reach, step back out before you'd get hit back.
Jab to the head, jab to the body
Same jab, two heights. Bend the knees for the body one, don't lean.
The first jab measures, the second hides the cross.
Jab, left hook to the body
Bend the knees to get low, turn the hip, elbow tight.
Dip, then drive it straight through, back up into your guard.
Freeze after every punch. If you could not throw again without stepping, your weight was off your feet.
Hands up, stay still. Switch legs every round.
Half speed, whole body behind every punch, feet planted.
Fast hooks and uppercuts to the body, guard back up between bursts.
Jab to measure, go to the body early, finish every combination balanced.
